Barbarian · Hybrid

Whirlwind Barbarian - Tower Push Variant

melee channelled AoE, leaderboard-tuned

Barbarian hybrid unchanged melee channelled AoE, leaderboard-tuned based on Whirlwind Barbarian

Last verified 2026-08-08 • Season 14

Move on whenLevel 70 and Pit Tier 10 cleared for Torment 1.
Move on whenGohr's Devastating Grips equipped and you are farming Superior Lair Keys for the Corrupted Reaper - that is when the Mythic decision arrives.
Move on whenMelted Heart of Selig equipped with a clean no-Life gear set, glyphs levelled evenly - go push.

Skill bar

1Lunging Strike
2Whirlwind
3Ground Stomp
4War Cry
5Challenging Shout
6Call of the Ancients

Rotation

Ground Stomp, shouts, spin. Lunging Strike when Fury is empty. Life affixes are fine at this stage - you have no Melted Heart of Selig yet.

Skill point priority

  1. Identical to barbarian-meta-whirlwind at this stage - there is nothing to hybridise before Torment 1
  2. Whirlwind max first for Dust Devils at level 15
  3. War Cry, then Lunging Strike, then Challenging Shout and Ground Stomp
  4. Call of the Ancients as the levelling ultimate

Skill bar

1Whirlwind
2Iron Skin
3War Cry
4Challenging Shout
5Rallying Cry
6Wrath of the Berserker

Rotation

Spin continuously, shouts and Wrath of the Berserker on cooldown, Iron Skin proactively before you take a hit rather than reactively after. No Lunging Strike safety net, so keep Rallying Cry honest for resource.

Skill point priority

  1. Whirlwind max with the Tornado upgrade
  2. Wrath of the Berserker max - the +30% window is the tuning target of this whole variant
  3. War Cry max for Vulnerable
  4. Iron Skin in the slot the base build gives to Lunging Strike
  5. Warbringer passive for Fortify

Rotation

Unchanged loop, but audit your gear for stray Life affixes every time you swap a piece - one forgotten Life roll silently shrinks Melted Heart of Selig. Mercenary: Raheir hired for the cheat-death, Aldkin's Field of Languish as reinforcement.

Skill point priority

  1. Whirlwind, Wrath of the Berserker and War Cry maxed
  2. Iron Skin and Challenging Shout at functional ranks
  3. Everything else into damage reduction passives

Skill bar

1Whirlwind

3War Cry
4Challenging Shout
5Rallying Cry
6Wrath of the Berserker

Rotation

Pull wide, War Cry for Vulnerable, Wrath of the Berserker, spin through the +30% window, Iron Skin before the dangerous elite lands its telegraph. If you stall two Tower tiers below your Pit ceiling, respec to Rend rather than regearing - Rend is what is actually topping Tower leaderboards this season.

Skill point priority

  1. Maxed Whirlwind, Wrath of the Berserker, War Cry
  2. Iron Skin held for the moment before a dangerous pull, not spent on trash
  3. Defensive passives over marginal damage passives

How to run them

Same pairing as the base build - Raheir hired with Ground Slam, Bastion, Inspiration and Raheir's Aegis, Aldkin reinforcing with Field of Languish - and on this variant the choice is less optional than it is on the base build. Tower floors kill you through incoming damage rather than through a damage check, so Raheir's Valiance cheat-death and Aldkin's area damage reduction are both doing real work. Icy Veins' Varyana/Bloodthirst reinforcement is the offensive alternative and is the wrong side of the trade here: this variant already gave up Lunging Strike for Iron Skin on the same reasoning.

Plan

Same system and the same caveat as the base build: Maxroll ships one generic default War Plans tree for every Season 14 Whirlwind profile and explicitly tells you to adapt it. The adaptation for a Tower variant is to weight The Pit and Nightmare Dungeons over the material-farming trees, because what gates a Tower push is glyph level, not gear acquisition.

Uniques & where to find them

Gohr's Devastating Gripsgloves

Target-farm Grigoire, the Galvanic Saint — an Initiate-tier Lair boss (costs 1 Lair Key) — for this Barbarian glove unique. Backup: Horadric Cube 'Upgrade to Unique' recipe (Common gloves + 1 Enhanced Primordial Dust + 10 Primordial Dust) rerolls a random gloves-slot unique.

Where →
Tuskhelm of Joritz the Mightyhelm

Target-farm Bartuc, the alternate final boss inside Infernal Hordes — skip the Fel Council and spend 666 Burning Aether to open his chamber instead; he is the dedicated drop source for this Barbarian helm.

Where →
Tibault's Willpants

No dedicated boss this season — Season 14 moved it off boss loot tables. Farm it via the Horadric Cube: Common pants + 1 Enhanced Primordial Dust + 10 Primordial Dust rerolls into a random pants-slot unique; save duplicates for the 3-identical-uniques 'Recycle' recipe to push toward better affixes.

Where →
Melted Heart of Seligamulet

Mythic Unique — any boss has a small chance to drop it directly, and Corrupted Reaper in the Pandemonium Threshold has the best Mythic drop rate in the game. To guarantee it, craft via the Horadric Cube with 4 Pandemonium Fragments (farmed from Corrupted Reaper) or via the Jeweler with Runes + Resplendent Sparks — only one crafted Mythic can be equipped at a time.

Where →
The Grandfatherweapon

Mythic Unique — any boss can drop it at a rare rate (Corrupted Reaper has the best odds), or craft it via the Horadric Cube (4 Pandemonium Fragments) or the Jeweler. This build slots dropped copies rather than crafting, since Melted Heart of Selig already occupies the single crafted-Mythic slot.

Where →
Ramaladni's Magnum Opusweapon

Target-farm The Butcher at Greater Lair tier (costs 1 Greater Lair Key) — he is the dedicated Barbarian source for this weapon; alternative dropped-Mythic slot alongside or instead of The Grandfather.

Where →
Ring of Starless Skiesring

Mythic Unique with no dedicated boss: every Lair boss can drop it, or craft it in the Horadric Cube with Pandemonium Fragments - remembering that only one Cube-crafted Mythic may be equipped at a time.

D4 Loot Filter — Barbarian filter finder

diablofilter.com/browse returned HTTP 403 on 2026-08-08 (confirmed twice, unreachable); verified diablo4lootfilter.com/filters instead. No public permalink for a Whirlwind-specific Barbarian filter was exposed via automated fetch, so this links the site's real class/build Finder — search class Barbarian, build Whirlwind, and prefer the strict/push strictness tier for Tower and high-Pit pushing rather than the general endgame code.

Summary

The meta Whirlwind build, retuned for Tower and high Pit tiers rather than general farming. Two facts from the knowledge base drive every change: Maxroll's week-1 review reports that Rend and Flame Charge - not Whirlwind - are the Barbarian builds dominating Tower leaderboards, and Maxroll's push list puts five Barbarian builds in S tier while its overall endgame list puts three. So the same class carries you either way, but the tuning differs. This variant keeps the Whirlwind engine (which you have already geared) and shifts affixes, defensive slots and the Mythic choice toward surviving and sustaining at push tiers, where a single mistake ends the run. Take this only after barbarian-meta-whirlwind is fully geared - it is a retune, not a fresh character.

Reasoning

Based onWhirlwind Barbarian
Tweaks vs. the base build
  1. Drop Lunging Strike for Iron Skin from early_endgame onward, not just at the pushing stage. Reason: the base build keeps Lunging Strike as a Fury fallback, but 3.1.0 capped Fury generation at 0.5 Fury per 1% Maximum Life and cut it off from Resource Generation bonuses, so the fallback returns less than it used to while the survivability slot is worth strictly more at push tiers.
  2. Prioritise Cooldown Reduction over Attack Speed on gloves and amulet. Reason: Wrath of the Berserker now grants a flat +30% all damage for its duration in 3.1.x, so uptime on that one button is a bigger multiplier than incremental spin speed once your attack-speed breakpoint is already met.
  3. Keep Melted Heart of Selig as the crafted Mythic and be strict about it: zero Life affixes anywhere on gear. Reason: the Mythic doubles your resource pool and converts it into your effective life pool, so Life rolls dilute it. Season 14 allows only ONE crafted Mythic equipped at a time, so this is the whole crafted-Mythic budget - do not craft a second and expect to use both.
  4. Slot dropped Mythic weapons (The Grandfather or Ramaladni's Magnum Opus) rather than crafting them. Reason: the one-crafted-Mythic limit applies only to crafted items - dropped Mythics are unlimited, and the Corrupted Reaper in the Pandemonium Threshold has the best Mythic drop rates in the game. Since patch 3.1.2 Mythics can also be recycled, so a wrong craft is recoverable.
  5. Farm Superior Lair Keys deliberately instead of opportunistically, and run Ruptures in Helltide zones rather than in the Pit. Reason: Ruptures spawn most often in Helltide zones and their spawn frequency was explicitly decreased in the Pit, so Pit runs are for pushing, not for seasonal loot.
  6. Do not slot Aspect of Walloping and do not build into 2-Handed Techniques. Reason: Walloping is confirmed non-functional with the Whirlwind Tornado upgrade, and 2-Handed Techniques are partially or wholly broken this patch. This matters more here than in the base build because push builds have no slack for a dead multiplier.
  7. Keep a Rend respec saved. Reason: Rend is S tier on the push list and is what is actually topping Tower leaderboards; if your Whirlwind clear stalls two tiers below your Pit ceiling, the class is not the problem and swapping skills is cheaper than regearing.
